title: Sprinklr Announces Date of Third Quarter Financial Results
summary: Sprinklr (NYSE: CXM), the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), today announced that the company’s third quarter financial results will be released before market open on December 2, 2026.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY — November 10, 2026 –**[Sprinklr](https://www.sprinklr.com/) (NYSE: CXM), the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), today announced that the company’s third quarter financial results will be released before market open on December 2, 2026. The company’s earnings press release will be made available on the Sprinklr Investor Relations website at[investors.sprinklr.com](https://investors.sprinklr.com/) .


Sprinklr will host a conference call to discuss its results at 8:30am ET the same day. Interested parties may register for and access the live webcast of the call at the website. To access the call by phone dial (877) 459-3955 or 1 (201) 689-8588 for international callers. Following the call, a replay will be available on the same website.


## About Sprinklr


[Sprinklr](https://www.sprinklr.com/) is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human intelligence with the enhancements and insights of artificial intelligence, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.


Today, 1,600+ enterprises — including Microsoft, P&G, Samsung, and 59% of the Fortune 100 — rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
